LESSON: THE COUNTY GOVERN MENTS IN KENYA

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Citizenshi p and Governan ce In Kenya
Topic 5.7: The County Govern ments in Kenya
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers The County Govern ments in Kenya, part of Citizenshi p and Governan ce In Kenya in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: Why is a county government important in Kenya? 2. How is the county government structured?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on The County Govern ments in Kenya together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to learn: learners develop relationships as they role-play the duties of a governor.

● Citizenship: learners acquire active community skills as they Watch video clips of a county governor or MCA carrying out their

duties/projects in the county

Values:
● Respect: learners enhance the skill of acceptance as they appreciate leaders while discussing in groups the role of a member of the

county assembly (MCAs)

● Patriotism: learners develop a love for their county as they role-play the duties of a governor

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs) :

Governance: Learners learn the structure and discuss the duties of the governor and members of the county assembly,

Links to other Learning Areas:
Creative Arts; Learners relate to skills learnt in Creative Arts as they role-play the duties of a governor.
